description_en: Saves instance tags in a batch
description_zh: 批量保存实例标签信息
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot save-annotation-mission-tag-info-list --annotation-mission-tag-info-list-json-string 'delete_:false,_InstanceId_:_00b37342-e759-4fe5-b296-aef775933af0_,_AnnotationMissionTagInfoName_:_测试数据1_,_AnnotationMissionTagInfoDescription_:_测试' --annotation-mission-tag-info-list Delete=true TenantId=bdbff6a5-1f68-4b41-8d37-6ff805ce165a InstanceId=bdbff6a5-1f68-4b41-8d37-6ff805ce165a AnnotationMissionTagInfoDescription=标签描述 AnnotationMissionTagInfoName=标签 AnnotationMissionTagInfoId=bdbff6a5-1f68-4b41-8d37-6ff805ce165a --reset false --instance-id af81a389-91f0-4157-8d82-720edd02b66a --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveAnnotationMissionTagInfoList

parameters.help_en:
The JSON-formatted data of the tags.

> The parameters in the JSON string are the same as those in AnnotationMissionTagInfoList. Specify either this parameter or AnnotationMissionTagInfoList
parameters.help_zh:
标签JSON数据

> json中具体的参数与AnnotationMissionTagInfoList参数相同，二者选其一填写即可
parameters.name: annotation_mission_tag_info_list_json_string

element_fields.help_en:
Indicates whether to delete the tag.

> Set this parameter to true to delete the tag. Set it to false to add the tag
element_fields.help_zh:
是否删除

> 选择true则是删除该标签，填入false则新增
element_fields.name: delete

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

> This parameter has the same function as AnnotationMissionTagInfoListJsonString. Specify either this parameter or AnnotationMissionTagInfoListJsonString
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表

> 与AnnotationMissionTagInfoListJsonString参数相同，二者选其一即可
parameters.name: annotation_mission_tag_info_list

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether to restore the default tag values
parameters.help_zh: 是否选择恢复默认标签值
parameters.name: reset
